verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the Literature agent searches and synthesizes across more than 175M papers, trials and patents. It understands citation graphs, journal quality and clinical-trial data, and findings can be traced back to the specific literature passage. That is squarely scholarly and primary-source search rather than open-web search, and the API exposes it through a dedicated LITERATURE job type. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of search coverage and accuracy.
